source: due2-native: an asset names its policy with odrl:hasPolicy (external review R07, #117)
notes: Valid ODRL 2.2: IM 2.2.3 infers ex:dataset as the target of every Rule of ex:licence, and tools/check_odrl22.py applies that inference before validating. due2 does not: W1 reads only the declared edges (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3), so it would drop the target. The author states it as odrl:target on the Policy or the Rule instead (decisions/0034).

expected_rejection.why: ex:dataset names ex:licence with odrl:hasPolicy, which due2 does not admit, and without that inference ex:read has no target. Both are stage-1 errors, so W1 reports both (decisions/0034).
